title: アドバンストバイオ情報
subtitle: Advanced Bioinformation and Brain Sciences
teachers:
SAGARA Jun-ichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) acquire knowledge of bioinformation and brain science.
(2) learn about life science and evolution
(3) learn about analysis of biological sequences (RNA)
(4) learn basic statistical mechanics for protein structure
advice:
This is an advanced course on bioinformatics. We will cover the following materials:

1. Evolutionary significance of biological sequences.
2. Methods of analysis of biological sequences.
3. Methods of analysis of protein structure.

Students will also learn advanced issues, such as stochastic context free-grammars.
Students are expected to understand the basics of bioinformation and brain science.
Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms used in basic bioinformatics and brain science.
Students are expected to solve the exercises independently.
Students should pay attention to the teacher’s instructions in the class since the schedules for quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses.
Students should attend all classes, as the handouts may not be received.
requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge on data analysis, fundamental bioinformatics and bioscience.
Sufficient knowledge of bioinformatics.
Basic knowledge of molecular biology.
How use a personal computer and internet communication technology.
